[2026-07-27 | AAPL | Hold | -9.9% | -12.5% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Hold AAPL at benchmark weight (one standard allocation ≈ a 5% portfolio position). Put no new capital to work at the 2026-07-27 close of 336.91 and cap gross exposure at benchmark — trim only any excess above it, do not go below. Pre-commit one-third tranches that fire only after the 7/29–7/30 macro window and the FQ3 print clear: a pullback into 326–330 holding the 10 EMA (326.79) with VWMA 324.54 intact and RSI ≥45; a >339.57 daily close on ≥60M shares with the MACD histogram positive; or a clean post-earnings confirmation on margins, mid-teens revenue growth and an AI-monetization path — capped at one standard allocation total. Hard review at a daily close below 319.35; trend failure below 306.99 (50 SMA) means reduce to token/zero and re-underwrite. Horizon 1–3 months tactical, core re-scored at the print.

**Investment Thesis**: The direction is settled and only the price is contested — and the tell is that all three risk seats independently refused to buy at the current print. Why not Sell/Underweight: the bull's substance was never dented — revenue +16.6%, gross margin 49.27% (+222bps YoY), operating income +21.3% ahead of revenue, H1 EPS +19.8%, ~$62B net cash, ~$78B FCF on capex −27.7%, with a fully stacked trend (price 21.9% above a rising 200 SMA at 276.38, 9.7% above a rising 50 SMA at 306.99, higher-low sequence 246.70 → 273.75 → 319.35 intact, VWMA rising to 324.54, no overhead supply above 339.57). Even the conservative analyst conceded it is a high-quality business and did not argue to reduce or short — capping how negative the call can honestly be. Why not Buy/Overweight at market: the bear won the arithmetic. From 336.91 upside to the 347.08 upper band is +3.0% versus −5.2% to the plan's 319.35 invalidation, −4.8% to the 320.63 stop and −8.9% to the 50 SMA — 1:1.6 to 1:3 against, with ATR 8.14 (2.42%) putting invalidation ~2.15 ATR away; the aggressive analyst's 2.5:1 applied only to the conditional 327 tranche, not the current tick. Three secondary bear points also stuck: unconfirmed breakout volume (47.5M/49.6M vs 60.96M/62.97M/63.41M on the prior leg; VWMA is backward-looking), two independent momentum divergences (MACD flat ~8.93 while price ran +3.2%; RSI 79.79 → 67.29 as price rose 8.0%), and the unexplained $12.8B gross / $13.3B → $25.8B net intangible jump — recast by the bull as 'option value' but ununderwritten until the filing shows an accretion path, especially with buybacks cut 25.3%. Add a ~35x back-of-envelope multiple (unverified, an annualization of H1 EPS) into a zero-disclosure print inside the Warsh press conference (7/29, 14:00 ET) and Thursday inflation data. Where the bear overreaches: the conservative analyst's demand to suspend Trigger B 'until the trend re-proves itself' is too rigid — the 60M-share/MACD-positive condition is itself a defined proof — and the sequential-margin comparison is a weaker test than the expanded YoY figure. The deciding synthesis is the neutral framework, which dominates both extremes: the aggressive analyst himself will not buy at 336.91 (his plan is scaled entries at 326–330 with a stop near 320.6, adding above 339.57 only on 60M+ volume) and the conservative analyst will not reduce. When the strongest advocate refuses to buy here and the strongest skeptic refuses to sell, the correct expression is Hold — maintain at benchmark, freeze new capital through the event, and let pre-committed triggers, not headlines, deploy the single standard allocation of incremental exposure afterward. Size for a ±2 ATR (~±5%) single-session move as normal, not a tail; if at or above benchmark and the desk can define event risk via puts/collar, hold the core rather than trading around the print. Upgrade to Overweight if the print shows YoY operating-margin expansion without soft AI commentary, EPS growth near the H1 ~20% pace, and a close above 339.57 on ≥60M shares. Downgrade to Underweight if a tranche is stopped at a close below 319.35, filing notes reveal a large all-time-high-priced acquisition with no accretion path while buybacks stay cut, or guidance points to sequential margin compression into FY2027. Gaps not closable from the material: no consensus, no guidance, no options-implied move, no short interest, no verified multiple, no filing confirmation of the intangible jump.

**Price Target**: 347.0

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months tactical, re-scored at the FQ3 print

REFLECTION:
The five-day window printed -9.9% raw and -12.5% alpha versus SPY, so the refusal to deploy new capital at 336.91 was correct in direction but the benchmark-weight Hold still absorbed nearly the whole drawdown; five days is too short to score a 1–3 month thesis, yet not too short to see that the ±2 ATR single-session sizing assumption badly understated a 5-day event-window move. What the window supports is the bear's asymmetry arithmetic (1:1.6 to 1:3 against buying) and the two momentum divergences plus unconfirmed breakout volume, which read as distribution rather than consolidation; what it undercuts is the bull's "fully stacked trend" and the 246.70 → 273.75 → 319.35 higher-low sequence, since a ~10% drop from 336.91 puts price through the 319.35 hard-review level and against the 306.99 50 SMA, meaning the plan's own trend-failure triggers should have fired. Lesson for the next similar setup: when the strongest advocate won't buy and the strongest skeptic won't sell, express that as reduced exposure rather than a frozen benchmark hold, and pre-commit a trim trigger alongside the additive tranches so a Hold cannot silently become a passive long into a 1:1.6–1:3 against payoff.

[2026-07-24 | AAPL | Hold | -7.2% | -8.3% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Maintain AAPL at benchmark/standard weight and put no new capital to work at $333.02. The uptrend is intact and the operating numbers are strong (foreclosing Underweight/Sell), but the setup is a failed retest into 334.68/334.99 resistance on soft momentum with a binary Q3 print days away, so the add case at spot is only ~1:1 (foreclosing Buy/Overweight). Keep the 2xATR trail near 316.49 on existing longs and act only on closing prints. Defer the bulk of any add budget until after earnings: a small 25-30% orderly pullback tranche in 324.50-327.70 only if it holds above 319.35, a partial breakout tranche requiring a daily close above 334.99 on >=60M shares with no RSI/MACD divergence, and a reserve released only on post-earnings confirmation (gross margin near 49%, opex growth decelerating below revenue, buybacks re-accelerating).

**Investment Thesis**: This is a genuine, balanced Hold: the two sides did not disagree about AAPL the company, they disagreed about AAPL the price, and each conceded the other's decisive ground. The bull owns direction and it is unrebutted — a perfectly stacked, rising MA ladder (200 SMA 275.98 < 50 SMA 306.23 up 28 straight sessions < VWMA 322.80 < 10 EMA 324.54 < close 333.02, price 20.7% above the 200), a 07-24 +3.53% engulfing reversal that reclaimed the 10 EMA, and dataset-best fundamentals (Q2 revenue +16.6% to $111.2B, gross margin 49.27% +222bps, operating margin 32.28% despite R&D +33.6%, EPS +21.8%, H1 FCF $78.3B, net cash rebuilt to ~$61.9B). Even the bear refused to short into a rising 50/200 stack, which rules out Underweight and Sell. The bear owns entry and that governs new capital: the $333.02 close is below the 07-17 close of $333.74 and the 07-24 high of 334.37 failed under the 334.68/334.99 shelf; breakout R/R is only ~1.0-1.1:1 with %B at 0.79 and ATR 8.26 (2.48% of price); volume of 47.5M beat the prior three sessions but lagged the 61-63M prints of 07-15/17, and the Aggressive 'distribution' label is plausible but unproven; the MACD histogram's 0.908 is only the first uptick off 0.795 versus the 3.337 peak while the MACD line already peaked at 8.927 on 07-21 during price chop, so a clear of 334.99 without momentum confirmation is divergence risk, not a win; RSI 65.23 has limited headroom. The quality-of-earnings jabs survive largely unanswered — opex +21.3% H1 vs revenue +16.1%, tax 15.0%->17.46%, buybacks -25% YTD/-53% in Q2, CFO flattered by $11.3B lower cash taxes with capex -27.7% and $12.5B net intangibles added, and the fundamentals are backward-looking (newest filing is the 10-Q accepted 2026-05-01). The tiebreaker is timing: prior entry-caution here has cost alpha, but the cross-ticker GOOGL lesson applies — into a binary event with ATR at 2.48% and an invalidation line (306.23) ~8% below, a reduced pre-earnings tranche still pays full gap risk for a fraction of the upside, so timing rather than sizing is the lever. I therefore adopt the Neutral analyst's amendment over both the Aggressive 50% pre-earnings pullback tranche and the Conservative full removal/trim: hold the core, no new capital at spot, keep the volatility-aware trail, and cap total pre-earnings deployment near one-quarter to one-third of the add budget with the rest reserved for after the print. I would not go Underweight (the bear never argued the business or trend was impaired, and trimming into strength at a rising 50/200 stack before a catalyst is a worse trade than trailing), and I would not go Overweight (the disciplined bull case is 'wait for the pullback zone or confirmed breakout,' which is not what an Overweight instructs today). What would change it: upgrade toward Overweight on a post-Q3 close above 334.99 on >=60M shares with no divergence, or a controlled pullback into 324.50-327.70 that holds above 319.35 with gross margin near 49%; downgrade toward Underweight on a close below 319.35 combined with the MACD line rolling under its signal and histogram back below 0.79, or a Q3 print with revenue growth materially below ~10% or gross margin well below 48%, with 306.23 (50 SMA) as medium-term invalidation. Missing from the record and flagged, not papered over: no valuation multiples, no consensus target level or the size of the gap-to-spot, no guidance/segment splits, and no confirmed earnings date — so any price target here is technical, not valuation-derived.

**Price Target**: 345.0

**Time Horizon**: 3-6 months (spanning the imminent Q3 FY2026 print)

REFLECTION:
The -8.3% alpha over five days (raw -7.2%) supports the entry-side caution that drove the Hold: refusing new capital at $333.02 into a failed retest with a binary print days away avoided a gap-loss on fresh money. It undercuts the bull's "uptrend intact" leg and validates the GOOGL lesson that timing, not sizing, is the lever for pre-earnings deployment — though five days spanning an earnings gap is too short to judge a 3-6 month thesis or the $345 target. Lesson: when ATR is ~2.5% and a binary catalyst is imminent, treat the pre-print pullback tranches as effectively void and wait for closing prints after the event rather than staging any tranche in advance.

[2026-07-23 | AAPL | Underweight | +3.7% | +3.2% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Trim AAPL 20% now (25–30% only if the position is at/above target weight or tech is already overweight), selling into strength at $322.66–$327.74 rather than into weakness, and retain a 70–80% core because the primary uptrend is intact. Do not add at $321.66 and do not pre-commit the proceeds to a $315.20–$317.40 dip-buy; that shelf only becomes a buy if AAPL stabilizes on contracting volume, reclaims $321.38, and MACD holds above its 7.31 signal. Invalidation is symmetric: a close above $334.99 on >60M shares with MACD re-accelerating re-adds the trimmed portion, while a daily close below $305.47 (50 SMA) cuts the tactical remainder and $275.60 (200 SMA) is full-thesis invalidation. **Investment Thesis**: All three risk desks converge on a partial trim, so the only contested questions are the label, the size, and the proceeds. On the provided scale Sell means exit or avoid entry, which no desk advocates — the trader's own reasoning says "a full exit is unwarranted" — so the correct rating is Underweight: reduce exposure, take partial profits, keep the core.

Direction is decided by the fact that the bear/neutral evidence is an actual rejection, not proximity to resistance. AAPL closed at $321.66 below the 10 EMA at $322.66 (first such close since 6/30) after four consecutive lower closes off a +21.3% move in fifteen sessions, with MACD rolling off 8.927 on a contracting histogram and price just $0.28 above the VWMA at $321.376 — the entire July breakout cohort is at breakeven. That gate matters because of my own record: the 2026-07-13 Underweight (+3.9% alpha against me) and the 2026-07-10 Hold both failed by treating a nearby technical level inside one ATR as a rejection rather than a probable break. Those lessons required an actual rejection signal before trimming; that gate is now satisfied. The 2026-07-16 Overweight near $333, made into the parabolic extension, cost -1.8% alpha in five days — the freshest datapoint supports the trim.

Size is capped at a modest trim, not the conservative desk's cascade, because structure is unbroken: price remains above a rising 50 SMA at $305.47 and rising 200 SMA at $275.60, RSI 58.11 is still above 50 and reset without bearish divergence, MACD 8.107 remains above its 7.312 signal, and none of $319.35, $317.32 or $315.20–$317.40 has been decisively violated. The conservative schedule (30% plus further cuts at $321.38, $317.32 and $305.47) risks becoming a disguised liquidation on a sideways chop, and this desk's history of over-trimming confirmed uptrends is why I reject it.

First, I reject the aggressive "paid either way" framing: the $315.20–$317.40 reload is not free optionality — if $321.38 fails and MACD crosses below 7.31, that shelf becomes resistance. Proceeds sit in cash/short duration until stabilization is demonstrated. It argues for smaller size and wider bands, which is precisely what a 20–30% trim with a retained 70–80% core delivers.
